senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="O00242">same</cite> Targ. II Esth. III, 3 <he>סָג יתיה</he> (not <he>סגיתיה</he>).—Part. <he>סָיֵיג</he>, <cite ref="O00549"><he>סָיֵג</he></cite>.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Hosea 2:8">Targ. Hos. II, 8</cite> <he>כמא דסַיְגִין</he> (missing in ed. Lag.).—Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᶜ top <he>יְסוּג תורעתך</he> may the Lord fence in thy breach (guard thee from further trouble); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100">Gen. R. s. 100</cite>. Y. Kidd. I, end, 61ᵈ; Y. Shebu. II, end, 33ᶜ, a. e. <he>סָיְיגִין סייגה ותרעין וכ׳</he> a fence is fenced around, and a breach broken into, i.e. the good are assisted by Providence in their good work, and the bad in their evil ways; <he>וכיני סייגין וכ׳</he> (not <he>ובני</he>) but is it right that the fence &c.?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 935">Yalk. Prov. 935</cite> <he>סגיי סוגייא</he> (corr. acc.).
